entities.name: Reinhold Johan von Fersen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Reinhold Johan von Fersen was the governor of Västerbotten County from 1688 to 1692 and of Halland County from 1705 to 1709. His son was Hans Reinhold Fersen (1683–1736).
